import json
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, '/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/scripts/aws')
from signed_requests import observe_json

ROOT = Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd')
SOURCE = Path(__file__).read_text()
TASK = {'Type':'Task','Resource':'arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke','Parameters':{'FunctionName':'stackd-teststate-mock-no-resource'},'End':True}
MAP = {'Type':'Map','ItemsPath':'$.items','ItemSelector':{'i.$':'$$.Map.Item.Index','v.$':'$$.Map.Item.Value'},'ItemProcessor':{'ProcessorConfig':{'Mode':'INLINE'},'StartAt':'Child','States':{'Child':{'Type':'Pass','End':True}}},'End':True}
PARALLEL = {'Type':'Parallel','Branches':[{'StartAt':'A','States':{'A':{'Type':'Pass','End':True}}},{'StartAt':'B','States':{'B':{'Type':'Pass','End':True}}}],'End':True}
CASES = []
def add(label, definition, mock=None, **kwargs):
    data={'definition':json.dumps(definition,separators=(',',':')),'input':'{"items":[1,2,3]}','inspectionLevel':'DEBUG'}
    if mock is not None: data['mock']=mock
    data.update(kwargs)
    CASES.append((label,data))
add('mock-task-empty',TASK,{})
add('mock-task-null',TASK,{'result':'null'})
add('mock-task-object',TASK,{'result':'{"Payload":{"ok":true}}'})
add('mock-task-schema-type',TASK,{'result':'{"StatusCode":"wrong"}'})
add('mock-task-schema-present',TASK,{'result':'{"StatusCode":"wrong"}','fieldValidationMode':'PRESENT'})
add('mock-task-schema-none',TASK,{'result':'{"StatusCode":"wrong"}','fieldValidationMode':'NONE'})
add('mock-task-both',TASK,{'result':'{}','errorOutput':{'error':'Owned.Error','cause':'mock'}})
add('mock-error-empty',TASK,{'errorOutput':{}})
add('mock-error-retry',dict(TASK,Retry=[{'ErrorEquals':['Owned.Error'],'IntervalSeconds':2,'MaxAttempts':3,'BackoffRate':2}]),{'errorOutput':{'error':'Owned.Error','cause':'mock'}},stateConfiguration={'retrierRetryCount':1})
add('mock-error-catch',dict(TASK,Catch=[{'ErrorEquals':['Owned.Error'],'ResultPath':'$.error','Next':'Caught'}]),{'errorOutput':{'error':'Owned.Error','cause':'mock'}})
add('mock-pass-rejected',{'Type':'Pass','End':True},{'result':'{}'})
add('pass-no-role',{'Type':'Pass','End':True})
add('trace-pass',{'Type':'Pass','End':True},inspectionLevel='TRACE')
add('mock-reveal-false',TASK,{'result':'{}'},revealSecrets=False)
add('mock-context-partial',dict(TASK,Parameters={'FunctionName':'stackd-teststate-mock-no-resource','Payload.$':'$$'}),{'result':'{}'},context='{"State":{"Name":"Configured"}}')
add('mock-map-default',MAP,{'result':'[10,20,30]'})
add('mock-map-shape',MAP,{'result':'{}'})
add('mock-map-error-source-absent',MAP,{'errorOutput':{'error':'Owned.Error','cause':'mock'}})
add('mock-map-error-source',MAP,{'errorOutput':{'error':'Owned.Error','cause':'mock'}},stateConfiguration={'errorCausedByState':'Child'})
add('mock-parallel',PARALLEL,{'result':'[1,2]'})
add('mock-parallel-short',PARALLEL,{'result':'[1]'})
add('mock-parallel-object',PARALLEL,{'result':'{}'})
DISTRIBUTED = dict(MAP,ItemProcessor={'ProcessorConfig':{'Mode':'DISTRIBUTED'},'StartAt':'Child','States':{'Child':{'Type':'Pass','End':True}}},ItemBatcher={'MaxItemsPerBatch':2},MaxConcurrency=2,ToleratedFailureCount=1)
add('mock-map-batch',DISTRIBUTED,{'result':'[10,20,30]'})
add('mock-map-failure-count',DISTRIBUTED,{'result':'[10,20,30]'},stateConfiguration={'mapIterationFailureCount':2})
add('mock-map-excess-failure-count',DISTRIBUTED,{'result':'[10,20,30]'},stateConfiguration={'mapIterationFailureCount':4})
READER = dict(DISTRIBUTED,ItemReader={'Resource':'arn:aws:states:::s3:getObject','ReaderConfig':{'InputType':'JSON','ItemsPointer':'/items'},'Parameters':{'Bucket':'stackd-teststate-no-resource','Key':'none.json'}})
READER.pop('ItemsPath')
add('mock-map-reader',READER,{'result':'[10,20]'},stateConfiguration={'mapItemReaderData':'{"items":[4,5]}'})
add('mock-map-reader-missing-data',READER,{'result':'[10,20]'})
assert len(CASES)<=30
capture={'service':'stepfunctions','region':'us-east-1','captured_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'protocol':{'operation':'TestState','maximum_calls':30,'resource_creation':False,'real_tasks':False,'all_task_and_branch_cases_explicitly_mocked':True},'sources':[{'path':__file__,'content':SOURCE},{'path':'scripts/aws/signed_requests.py','content':(ROOT/'scripts/aws/signed_requests.py').read_text()},{'url':'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/test-state-isolation.html'}],'observations':[]}
for label, data in CASES:
    result=observe_json('states.us-east-1.amazonaws.com','states','AWSStepFunctions.TestState',data)
    capture['observations'].append({'label':label,'operation':'TestState','input':data,'result':result})
    print(label,json.dumps(result),flush=True)
    (ROOT/'testdata/aws/stepfunctions/test_state_mock.json').write_text(json.dumps(capture,indent=2)+'\n')

"""Signed AWS requests for behavior probes that bypass CLI shape validation."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import hmac
import json
import subprocess
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from collections.abc import Mapping
from typing import Any

from aws_cli import ProbeResult

_RAW_CREDENTIALS = None


def signed_post(endpoint, service, body, headers, environment=None):
    global _RAW_CREDENTIALS
    credentials = _RAW_CREDENTIALS if environment is None else None
    if credentials is None:
        process = subprocess.run(["aws", "configure", "export-credentials", "--format", "process"],
                                 capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30, env=environment)
        if process.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError("Unable to load AWS credentials for signed requests; diagnostics discarded")
        credentials = json.loads(process.stdout)
        if environment is None:
            _RAW_CREDENTIALS = credentials
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    date, instant = now.strftime("%Y%m%d"), now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
    headers = dict(headers, host=endpoint)
    headers["x-amz-date"] = instant
    if credentials.get("SessionToken"):
        headers["x-amz-security-token"] = credentials["SessionToken"]
    names = ";".join(sorted(headers))
    canonical = "POST\n/\n\n" + "".join(name + ":" + headers[name] + "\n" for name in sorted(headers)) + "\n" + names + "\n" + hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()
    scope = date + "/us-east-1/" + service + "/aws4_request"
    signing_key = ("AWS4" + credentials["SecretAccessKey"]).encode()
    for item in (date, "us-east-1", service, "aws4_request"):
        signing_key = hmac.new(signing_key, item.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()
    signature = hmac.new(signing_key, ("AWS4-HMAC-SHA256\n" + instant + "\n" + scope + "\n" + hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode()).hexdigest()).encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    headers["Authorization"] = "AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=" + credentials["AccessKeyId"] + "/" + scope + ", SignedHeaders=" + names + ", Signature=" + signature
    request = urllib.request.Request("https://" + endpoint + "/", data=body, headers=headers)
    try:
        response = urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        response = error
    with response:
        return response.status, response.read()


def observe_json(endpoint: str, service: str, target: str,
                 parameters: Mapping[str, Any], environment: Mapping[str, str] | None = None) -> ProbeResult:
    """Observe one AWS JSON call, retaining native error fields and HTTP status.

    Like signed_post, this signs for us-east-1 without retrying. Non-JSON or
    unmodeled errors raise rather than becoming invented AWS observations.
    """
    status, body = signed_post(endpoint, service, json.dumps(parameters).encode(),
                               {"content-type": "application/x-amz-json-1.0", "x-amz-target": target},
                               environment)
    output = json.loads(body)
    if 200 <= status < 300:
        return {"code": "Success", "output": output, "http_status": status}
    return {"code": output["__type"].split("#")[-1], "error": output, "http_status": status}

import json
import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd')
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'scripts/aws'))
from aws_cli import run,result
capture=json.loads((ROOT/'testdata/aws/stepfunctions/test_state_mock.json').read_text())
source=Path('/tmp/stackd_sfn_teststate_mock_probe.py').read_text()
namespace={'__file__':'/tmp/stackd_sfn_teststate_mock_probe.py'}
exec(source.split('assert len(CASES)')[0],namespace)
cases=dict(namespace['CASES'])
selected=['mock-task-empty','mock-task-null','mock-error-empty','mock-error-retry','mock-error-catch','pass-no-role','trace-pass','mock-reveal-false','mock-context-partial','mock-map-shape','mock-map-error-source-absent','mock-map-error-source','mock-parallel-short','mock-parallel-object','mock-map-batch','mock-map-failure-count','mock-map-excess-failure-count','mock-map-reader','mock-map-reader-missing-data']
for label in selected:
 data=cases[label]
 definition=json.loads(data['definition'])
 if definition.get('Type')=='Map' and definition['ItemProcessor']['ProcessorConfig']['Mode']=='DISTRIBUTED':
  definition['ItemProcessor']['ProcessorConfig']['ExecutionType']='STANDARD'
  data['definition']=json.dumps(definition,separators=(',',':'))
string_payload=dict(cases['mock-task-object'],mock={'result':'{"Payload":"{\\"ok\\":true}"}'})
work=[(label,cases[label]) for label in selected]+[('mock-task-string-payload',string_payload)]
assert len(work)<=20
environment=dict(os.environ,AWS_REGION='us-west-2',AWS_DEFAULT_REGION='us-west-2',AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS='1',AWS_IGNORE_CONFIGURED_ENDPOINT_URLS='true',AWS_PAGER='')
for key in list(environment):
 if key.startswith('AWS_ENDPOINT_URL'): del environment[key]
capture['sources'].append({'path':__file__,'content':Path(__file__).read_text()})
capture['followup_protocol']={'region':'us-west-2','maximum_calls':20,'retry':False,'resource_creation':False,'real_tasks':False}
for index,(label,data) in enumerate(work):
 if index: time.sleep(1.05)
 observed=result(run('stepfunctions','test-state',data,environment,options=['--endpoint-url','https://states.us-west-2.amazonaws.com'],timeout=30))
 capture['observations'].append({'label':'paced-west-'+label,'region':'us-west-2','operation':'TestState','input':data,'result':observed})
 print(label,json.dumps(observed),flush=True)
 (ROOT/'testdata/aws/stepfunctions/test_state_mock.json').write_text(json.dumps(capture,indent=2)+'\n')

findings.finding: Native us-west-2 accepts TRACE on a Pass state and revealSecrets:false with an explicit mock, contrary to stricter documentation wording.

A provided Context replaces the generated Context object, rather than merging missing default sections. Native nested stateName tests still expose State.Name=StateName and do not automatically expose Map.Item.
Lambda mocked Payload is a string in STRICT/PRESENT validation; a raw JSON text string is accepted. NONE accepts a JSON object Payload without rewriting it.

Map inspection omits absent selector/batcher stages and Parameters/result; default maxConcurrency is 0. ItemBatcher inspection represents each Items element as a JSON text string while the final output is the supplied mock result.

Map mock result length is checked against post-batch iteration count; failure threshold evaluation precedes result cardinality validation. ItemReader requires supplied raw data and applies ItemsPointer before selection/batching.
MapIterationFailureCount is rejected when testing a nested Task rather than the Map itself.
Retry/catch use compiled failure handlers, with retry count1 yielding backoff4 for interval2/backoff2; caught errors retain original input under ResultPath.

limitations: All27 us-east-1 attempts were throttled, including the first; those calls provide no semantic evidence.
No IAM role, state machine, activity, or integrated resource was created. All Task/Map/Parallel executions used explicit mocks.
HTTP transport/revealSecrets:true and actual task effects were not exercised by this capture.
